decisions.reason: Selecting Balanced Flow changes the complete wordmark's kerning, not the approved Hero V geometry; the message explicitly preserves both V forms' established geometry.
The kerning selection does not change the preferred Satin Reflection finish, selective gold distribution, or pending status of the final material-treatment decision.
Balanced Flow changes spacing between letters but does not change the construction, proportions, or architectural language of the letterforms themselves.
The selected kerning does not alter the second V's form, hierarchy, or construction; terminal refinements in the same message belong to the independently modeled shared-terminal Requirement.
The kerning choice does not change the accent's literal derivation, copied geometry, peak alignment, or revision policy; shared-terminal styling is represented separately.
Balanced Flow is consistent with the existing elegance and luxury goals but does not modify the broader brand-expression Requirement.

The source Requirement's kerning selection does not itself change terminal language; the independent terminal directive in message 189 is already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY under this candidate.
Choosing a kerning option does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
